title: Space Dodger 3D: Starfall Odyssey
description: An eighteen-sector 3D space campaign with original GLB spacecraft, reactive bosses, rescue missions, ion storms, command relays, an Ark escort, gravity gates, saved checkpoints and separate audio controls.

controls.desktop: WASD or Arrow Keys to fly, Space or mouse/tap to shoot, Shift to boost. E releases plasma; P/Esc pauses; M mutes. Automatic fire is adjustable.
controls.mobile: Use on-screen thrusters, FIRE and BOOST buttons. Drag the canvas to fly; PLASMA releases a stored charge.

features: AI enemy ships and enemy shooting
Detailed solid GLB spacecraft and citadel
Eighteen cinematic sector backgrounds with forward star parallax
Shaded planetary surfaces and refined landmarks
Six rescue, storm, relay, escort, gravity and Sovereign missions
Pause, mute, auto-fire and separate music/effects volumes
Compatibility flight on devices without WebGL
